title: AnswerRequest
description: The body of POST /answer: the question, how many sources the answer may draw on at most, and what narrows the search. The same shape as the search request today; a separate schema so the two may grow apart.

question.description: The question, as asked; blank or longer than the served configuration allows is rejected.

top_k.description: Sources wanted; the served default when absent or null, capped by the served maximum, at least one.

asset_version.description: Only sources of this asset version.
